neighbours.label: the determiner or 'of' that opens a postponed object after an intervening phrase (heavy-NP shift): 'announced to Congress ⟦his⟧ goal', 'the establishment by European nations ⟦of⟧ their outposts', 'hear in a republic ⟦a⟧ motion'; quiet when the object directly follows the verb
fire: The war ended with the transfer by the defeated states of their overseas territories.
The governor presented to the assembly her proposal to rebuild the harbor.
The study demonstrated through repeated trials the unexpected stability of the compound.
Nobody thought to find in such a village a library of that size.
The minister revealed to reporters his intention to resign before the vote.
The charter grants to each member state the right to leave the union.
The chemist added to the mixture a small amount of acid.
The judge read to the jury the instructions agreed by both sides.
quiet: The defeated states transferred their overseas territories when the war ended.
The governor presented her proposal to rebuild the harbor to the assembly.
The study demonstrated the unexpected stability of the compound through repeated trials.
Nobody thought to find a library of that size in such a village.
The minister revealed his intention to resign before the vote.
The charter grants each member state the right to leave the union.
The chemist added a small amount of acid to the mixture.
The judge read the instructions agreed by both sides to the jury.

notes: Card shows the same pattern in English, Spanish and French. Probes: shifted 0.82, 0.79, 0.53, 0.44, 0.44, and 'gave to the museum a collection' only 0.13; canonical order 0.003-0.007. Near misses are the same sentences in canonical order.
